items.title: Russia strikes Zelenskyy's hometown, killing 2
items.description: The attacks follow Russian President Vladimir Putin's vow of a "painful" response to Ukraine's attacks this week on the Kerch Bridge, linking Russian-occupied Crimea.

items.title: Italian ex-police chief accused in killing of judge found dead in apparent suicide
items.description: Gianni De Gennaro was placed under investigation last week by prosecutors in Sicily for alleged obstruction of justice linked to the investigation into the July 19, 1992, bombing in Palermo that killed anti-Mafia magistrate Paolo Borsellino and five members of his security detail.

items.title: Israeli strike on vehicle distributing food aid in Gaza kills three
items.description: Separately, Palestinian man is shot dead by Israeli forces in Jabalia and three people injured in attack in Khan Younis.

items.title: From Crimea to Kyiv, Bridges Become Targets in Russia’s War on Ukraine
items.description: Ukraine’s destruction of the Crimean Bridge’s road span and Russia’s strikes on Kyiv’s bridges mark the latest stages of each side’s war strategy.

items.title: Houthis launch strikes on Saudi Arabia
items.description: Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen continue to exchange strikes with the Saudi-led coalition. The coalition said it intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles fired towards Riyadh early on Saturday. items.title: Another day of survival for a family in Ukraine
items.description: On the outskirts of Kyiv, one family prepares for the fifth winter of war against Russia -- stockpiling food and fuel and trying to maintain as much a sense of normalcy as possible.

items.title: Russian Strike on Kryvyi Rih Wounds 58, Kills 7-Year-Old and Paramedic
items.description: A Russian ballistic missile strike on central Kryvyi Rih, a city in Ukraine’s Dnipropetrovsk region, on Friday evening, Nov. 20, killed a 7-year-old boy and a 20-year-old paramedic and injured 58 people, including four children, local officials said. items.title: At Least 9 Killed In Russian Attacks On Ukraine, Kyiv Bridges Damaged
items.description: At least nine people were killed and 28 injured on November 20 in an overnight Russian drone and ballistic missile attack on Ukraine. In Kyiv, damaged bridges have been partially closed to traffic, forcing residents to cross the Dnieper River on foot. Strikes also hit other regions.

items.title: What we know about the latest Russian missile strikes on Ukraine
items.description: Russia struck bridges and railway stations in the capital Kyiv in a major attack.

items.title: ‘You will not be alone’: General Assembly President tells Rohingya refugees after genocide ruling
items.description: A day after the UN’s highest court found that Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya, the President of the General Assembly visited the refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh, urging the world to turn the landmark judgement into action.

items.title: Step toward accountability: Top UN court finds Myanmar guilty of Rohingya genocide
items.description: Rohingya refugees around the world welcomed the ruling, which comes after a yearslong legal battle and decades of persecution in western Myanmar.
